# Links: the Hall, the stairwell, the chimney, and every link between zones

*Generated by tools/gen-zone-briefs.mjs from game/data/house.js: edit that, then re-run.*

## The house grid

```
y  0-2   attic            x 6-23 (att-*), chimney top x 24
y  3-5   upstairs         bedroom x 0-7 | hall 8-9 | bathroom 10-15 | stairwell 16-17 | study 18-23 | chimney flue 24
y  6-8   downstairs       pantry 0-4 | kitchen 5-15 | stairwell 16-17 | living room 18-24 (hearth 24, rows 7-8) | sunroom 25-31 (rows 5-8)
y  9-10  laundry          laundry 2-9 | ash pit 24
y 11-13  basement         basement 8-24 | dragon's lair 24-27
y 18-20  the tank         (opening only, off the map) x 0-3
```

One cell = 32x18 tiles. Rooms may not overlap; exits are automatic on shared edges (open tiles at the same world position on both sides). Everything outside a room's own edges is wall, except that nothing below an open bottom edge is a pit.

Linking spaces (hall, stairwell, chimney) go in `game/data/rooms/links.js` as three zone modules (n: 'hall', 'stairwell', 'chimney'; ZONE_INFO has their palettes, bg folder and music) or one module per space; the optional lair goes in `lair.js` (n: 'lair').

## The linking spaces

### hall-top: The Hall, Up High

Cell 8,3, 2x1 screens (64x18 tiles). Purpose: link, notCricket, shortcut.

You arrive on top of the bedroom door frame (a ledge at row 14 on the left). The smoke alarm on the ceiling (smoke-alarm-wall prop; not Beep, a cousin) chirps one high beep every 40 s: the first decoy, unreachable on the ceiling. The attic hatch is in the ceiling (cols 36-41 of the room): a C latch that can only be pounded from the attic side (shortcut down, late game). No walls within 12 tiles of the hatch are clingable (G).

- Not-Cricket / gag: hallAlarm (TEXT.npcs.hallAlarm or TEXT.oneLiners.hallAlarm)
- props: smoke-alarm-wall

Exits:
- left -> **bed-lair** (z01-bedroom, builder A) at cell 7,3 right of bed-lair, rows 10-13 **(exact)**; gate: rescue (stripe freed) built in the first room. floor row 14 on both sides; the boss module opens it when Stripe is freed
- bottom -> **hall-floor** (hall, builder D) at cell 8,3 bottom of hall-top, cols 0-31 (suggested); gate: oneWay one-way a->b (drop down; going back up needs Booties (G walls near the hatch))
- top -> **att-hatch** (z10-attic, builder D) at cell 9,2 bottom of att-hatch, cols 4-9 **(exact)**; gate: cereal (Thimble Helmet) one-way a->b built in the first room. the attic hatch latch: C tiles in att-hatch rows 16-17, cols 4-9 of cell x 9; hall-top leaves its top row open there (no clingable walls within 12 tiles below)

### hall-floor: The Hall

Cell 8,4, 2x2 screens (64x36 tiles). Purpose: link, loud, secret.

Drop from the door frame down picture frames and a coat hook (one-way ledges, no item needed downward; they do not climb back up past the door frame without Booties). Long runner rug to the Bathroom door (right, y 5). The robot vacuum sleeps on its dock in the linen-closet nook (left, y 5): its hum is a loud zone with a low ceiling; with the Cotton Earplugs you walk past it to a song-seed on the bottom linen shelf.

- loud zone(s): `{type:'loud'}` with a low ceiling across the passage

Exits:
- top -> **hall-top** (hall, builder D) at cell 8,3 bottom of hall-top, cols 0-31 (suggested); gate: oneWay one-way a->b (drop down; going back up needs Booties (G walls near the hatch))
- right -> **bath-door** (z02-bathroom, builder A) at cell 9,5 right of hall-floor, rows 12-15 **(exact)**; gate: open

Secrets:
- `hall-songseed-closet` songSeed: past the humming vacuum dock in the linen closet; needs **earplugs**

### stair-landing: The Landing

Cell 16,3, 2x2 screens (64x36 tiles). Purpose: link.

You arrive on the landing (left, y 4, from the tub rim). A baby gate (free-standing mesh, G, 9 tiles tall, no walls near it) blocks the top step. Two floss hooks above and before it let you swing and fling over (Floss: the gate between the Bathroom and the Kitchen). Beyond the gate the stairs go down (into stair-flight). To the right, across the open stairwell void (>= 10 tiles of air, G walls, no hooks within 7 tiles of the far side) is the Study door ledge (right edge, y 4): only a glide crosses (Glider). The Study ledge and its green lamp-glow are in view from the landing from the first visit (teaser). Falling into the void lands on the stairs below (not a pit).

Exits:
- left -> **bath-lair** (z02-bathroom, builder A) at cell 15,4 right of bath-lair, rows 12-15 **(exact)**; gate: rescue (katy freed) built in the first room. the boss module opens it when Katy is freed
- bottom -> **stair-flight** (stairwell, builder D) at cell 16,4 bottom of stair-landing, cols 8-31 (suggested); gate: hook (Floss Line) built in the first room (the baby gate (G, 9 tall) on the landing; hooks swing you over)
- right -> **stu-door** (z07-study, builder C) at cell 17,4 right of stair-landing, rows 8-11 **(exact)**; gate: glide (Dryer-Sheet Glider) built in the first room. stu-door has its ledge (floor) at row 12; the landing side is >= 10 tiles of void before the opening

### stair-flight: The Stairs

Cell 16,5, 2x2 screens (64x36 tiles). Purpose: link.

Carpeted steps (2 tiles high each, walkable both ways) zig-zag down. The banister rail runs above with spindle-top hooks (optional fun swings). Halfway down, a gap in the spindles on the right looks out over the Living Room: the curtain pelmet ledge (right edge, y 6) is 8+ tiles across open air from the nearest step: glide in (Glider; one of the two ways into the Living Room).

Exits:
- top -> **stair-landing** (stairwell, builder D) at cell 16,4 bottom of stair-landing, cols 8-31 (suggested); gate: hook (Floss Line) built in the first room (the baby gate (G, 9 tall) on the landing; hooks swing you over)
- bottom -> **stair-foot** (stairwell, builder D) at cell 16,6 bottom of stair-flight, cols 0-31 (suggested); gate: open
- right -> **liv-armchair** (z06-living, builder B) at cell 17,6 right of stair-flight, rows 4-7 **(exact)**; gate: glide (Dryer-Sheet Glider) built in the first room. the curtain pelmet ledge in liv-armchair at row 8 (cols 0-6); >= 8 tiles of open air from the nearest step

### stair-foot: The Foot of the Stairs

Cell 16,7, 2x2 screens (64x36 tiles). Purpose: link, save, hub.

The hallway floor at the bottom. A save crack (the hub between the Kitchen and the Living Room). Left (y 8): the Kitchen doorway, open. Right (y 8): the Living Room doorway, where the back of the armchair stands right inside (the Rubber Band's 9-tile G wall: the other way into the Living Room). Silverfish.

- save cracks: 1 (`S`)
- enemies: silverfish

Exits:
- top -> **stair-flight** (stairwell, builder D) at cell 16,6 bottom of stair-flight, cols 0-31 (suggested); gate: open
- left -> **kit-fridge** (z03-kitchen, builder A) at cell 16,8 left of stair-foot, rows 12-15 **(exact)**; gate: open
- right -> **liv-armchair** (z06-living, builder B) at cell 17,8 right of stair-foot, rows 12-15 **(exact)**; gate: height (Rubber Band) built in the second room. the armchair back: G, 9 tiles tall, its foot 2+ tiles inside liv-armchair

### chim-flue: The Flue

Cell 24,3, 1x4 screens (32x72 tiles). Purpose: link, secret.

4 screens of soot-slick brick (G: never clingable). A flutter-only climb (Swift Feather): brick lips 1 tile deep, alternating sides, each 4.5 tiles above the last, with soot overhangs that stop a straight super-jump; prove it with check-world --deny feather. Soot's lookout ledge halfway up (Lookout tower in the Carrier once she moves in) has a song-seed. The damper plate at the top (top edge, cols 12-19) is shut until nine crickets are home.

Exits:
- bottom -> **liv-hearth** (z06-living, builder B) at cell 24,7 top of liv-hearth, cols 12-19 **(exact)**; gate: chimney (Swift Feather) built in the second room. the flue throat; dropping down into the hearth is free
- top -> **chim-top** (chimney, builder D) at cell 24,3 top of chim-flue, cols 12-19 **(exact)**; gate: damper (9 rescues) built in the second room. the damper plate: solid until 9 rescues (see engine note in links.md)

Secrets:
- `chim-songseed-lookout` songSeed: Soot's lookout ledge halfway up the flue; needs **feather**

### chim-top: The Chimney Top

Cell 24,0, 1x3 screens (32x54 tiles). Purpose: link.

Above the damper: the chimney top, moonlight down the flue. The attic side (left edge, y 1, rows 10-13) is a gap in the brick into the attic.

Exits:
- bottom -> **chim-flue** (chimney, builder D) at cell 24,3 top of chim-flue, cols 12-19 **(exact)**; gate: damper (9 rescues) built in the second room. the damper plate: solid until 9 rescues (see engine note in links.md)
- left -> **att-entry** (z10-attic, builder D) at cell 24,1 left of chim-top, rows 10-13 **(exact)**; gate: open. floor row 14 on both sides

### chim-ash: The Ash Pit

Cell 24,9, 1x2 screens (32x36 tiles). Purpose: link, shortcut. Dark, needs: 'glow'.

Between the hearth's ash dump (top) and the chimney base (bottom). Dark. Falling down is free; climbing back up is a flutter climb (Swift Feather): a shortcut loop between the Basement and the Living Room.

Exits:
- top -> **liv-hearth** (z06-living, builder B) at cell 24,8 bottom of liv-hearth, cols 14-17 **(exact)**; gate: cereal (Thimble Helmet) built in the first room. the ash dump: C soot plug in liv-hearth rows 16-17, cols 14-17; chim-ash is dark (needs glow)
- bottom -> **bas-chimney** (z09-basement, builder C) at cell 24,10 bottom of chim-ash, cols 12-19 **(exact)**; gate: chimney (Swift Feather) one-way up needs feather built in the first room

## Gate cookbook (gate by kind first)

| gate | build it as | proof |
| - | - | - |
| cling (booties) | a # shaft 3-4 tiles wide with no ledges, taller than any jump (>= 6); G where clinging must not work | --deny booties |
| hook (floss) | H markers 5-6 tiles apart, each next one a tile or two lower, over a gap or past a G obstacle | --deny floss |
| water (raft) | ~ wider than any jump (>= 7) with no stepping stones | --deny raft |
| height (band) | a G wall >= 7 tiles high (Hump's leap is 5); no # nearby for wall-jumps | --deny band |
| glide (glider) | a gap >= 8 tiles of open air at the same height or lower, no hooks or walls within reach of the far side | --deny glider |
| cereal (thimble) | a C clump with an exposed top you can land on; it is solid from below and the sides (so a latch is one-way) | --deny thimble |
| dark (glow) | the room: dark: true, needs: 'glow', needsMsg: TEXT.gates.dark | --deny glow |
| loud (earplugs) | a {type:'loud'} box across the passage with a low ceiling so it can't be jumped over | --deny earplugs |
| chimney (feather) | a G shaft with 1-tile brick lips, alternating sides, 4.5 tiles apart, with a G overhang 2-3 tiles above each lip offset so a straight super-jump bonks; jump + flutter (2.5 + 2.5) reaches the next lip | --deny feather (strongest pass too) |
| crack (Mote) | % tiles; m markers are Mote-only hides | optional only |
| rescue | tiles that stay solid until the lair's cricket is rescued (lairs 1-3's onward exits); the gate entity, opens:{rescued} | replay |
| damper | tiles that stay solid until 9 rescues; the card lists who's missing (TEXT.damper, TEXT.ui.missingEntry) | goToRoom with 8 / 9 rescued |
| perk:* | optional secrets only: hugeLeap = a G ledge exactly 5 tiles up; wallRun = a # wall 3 tiles + a ledge; longGlide = a gap only 1-in-6 reaches; dash/shove/dig/duet need engine support | never on a main path |
| thermostat | a thermostat-lock prop + the room temp {left, right} gradient; Frost chirps at the target spot ({type:'thermostat'}) | check-world (--rescued frost) |
| oneWay | a drop down a G wall, one-way rungs (=) on one face only, or a C latch pounded from above | - |

## Engine features (built: exact syntax in design/ENGINE_NOTES.md, "Entities and mechanics"; zone-98 has a working example of each)

- **rescue gates**: `{type:'gate', id, x, y, w, h, opens:{rescued:'stripe'}}` (leave the tiles empty; the gate fills them with G until the rescue).
- **damper**: `{type:'gate', x, y, w, h, opens:{rescues: 9}, card:'damper'}` (chim-flue -> chim-top; touching it shows who is missing).
- **other gates**: `opens:{item}`, `opens:{switch: id}` (a `{type:'switch', id, x, y, by:'kick'|'up'|'pound'|'chirp'|'touch'}`, a thermostat or a piano), `opens:{side:'left'}` (one-way shortcut).
- **lifts**: `{type:'lift', kind:'steam'|'updraft'|'mister', x, y, w, h, vy, on, off, phase}` (updrafts only lift a gliding cricket).
- **springs**: `{type:'spring', x, y, w, power}` (cushions; hold Down to land still); aphids are springs (`{type:'aphid'}`).
- **terrain**: `{type:'terrain', kind:'syrup'|'crumble', x, y, w, h}`; soil/sand = `s` tiles (Digby digs); cereal/plaster = `C`.
- **piano keys**: `{type:'piano', id, x, y, kw, keys, melody:[0,2,1]}` (pound to play).
- **thermostat locks**: room `temp:{left, right}` + `{type:'thermostat', id, x, y, target}`; Frost chirps at the right spot.
- **doors**: `{type:'door', x, y, to, at, auto?, needs?}` (the laundry chute: `auto: true`, no door back).
- **NPCs**: `{type:'npc', who, x, y, talk, recruit, give?:'battery', giveTalk?}`; crumbs, seed-hearts, song-seeds: `{type:'crumbs'}`, `{type:'secret', id:'heart:...'|'song:...'}`.
- **decoys**: `{type:'decoy', voice, x, y, every: 40 | [8, 10], answers: true}` (or zone.decoys / room decoys with the same fields).
- **enemies**: every design enemy by its sprite folder name (ant mites silverfish mosquito cockroach fruitflies weevil antsoldier clothesmoth earwig dustbunny stinkbug booklouse wolfspider wasp aphid centipede cellarspider beetle vacuum).
- **bosses**: `makeBoss(name, {phases, start, tick, draw})` from src/bosses/base.js (phase checkpoints, tells, Gentle Mode, fixed chirp, rescue); see src/bosses/practice.js.
